text: Debugging is an important skill for any programmer. When your code does not work as expected, the first step is identifying bugs. You need to find where the problem comes from and understand why it happens. Debugging tools, such as breakpoints and step-by-step execution, can help you examine your code closely. However, a systematic approach is even more important. Instead of changing things randomly, test one part at a time and check the results. Logging is also very useful because it records what your program does while it runs. By reading these logs, you can often spot errors quickly and fix them more efficiently.
